Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the Washington manufacturing innovation and modernization extension service program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the Washington manufacturing innovation andmodernization extension service program; amending RCW 43.131.409 and43.131.410; and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, a credit isallowed for participants in the Washington manufacturing innovation andmodernization extension service program created in RCW 43.338.020. Thecredit allowed under this section is equal to fifty percent of thevalue of a program participant's contributions to the manufacturinginnovation and modernization account created in RCW 43.338.030. If aparticipant in the program does not meet the qualifications in RCW43.338.020(2)(b)(iv), the participant must remit to the department thevalue of any credits taken plus interest. The credit earned by aparticipant in one calendar year may be carried over to be creditedagainst taxes incurred in subsequent calendar years. The annualstatewide credit available is limited to one million two hundredtwentyfive thousand dollars.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.131.409 and 2008 c 315 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington manufacturing innovation and modernization extensionservice program under chapter 43.338 RCW shall be terminated June 30,((2012)) 2017, as provided in RCW 43.131.410.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.131.410 and 2008 c 315 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts, as now existing or hereafteramended, are each repealed, effective June 30, ((2013)) 2018: (1) RCW 43.338.005 and 2008 c 315 s 1; (2) RCW 43.338.010 and 2009 c 565 s 43 & 2008 c 315 s 2; (3) RCW 43.338.020 and 2008 c 315 s 3; (4) RCW 43.338.900 and 2008 c 315 s 4; (5) RCW 43.338.030 and 2008 c 315 s 5; ((and)) (6) RCW 43.338.040 and 2008 c 315 s 6; and (7) Section 1 of this act.
